title: MANDATORY USE OF THE GOVERNMENT TRAVEL CHARGE CARD (GTCC) DURING PERMANENT CHANGE OF STATION (PCS) TRAVEL
text: The Department of Defense (DoD) policy is the GTCC will be used by all eligible DoD travelers to pay for costs related to official government travel.

title: MANDATORY USE OF THE GOVERNMENT TRAVEL CHARGE CARD (GTCC) DURING PERMANENT CHANGE OF STATION (PCS) TRAVEL
text: Commanders must ensure GTCC training is conducted at the following website utilizing Microsoft Edge browser: https://secure.defensetravel.dod.mil/neowbtraining/Travel_Card/lessons/index. php.

title: MANDATORY USE OF THE GOVERNMENT TRAVEL CHARGE CARD (GTCC) DURING PERMANENT CHANGE OF STATION (PCS) TRAVEL
text: Additionally, in coordination with the Supply officer and Command Pay and Personnel Administrator (CPPA), Sailors must be counseled by the Command Financial Specialist or Agency Program Coordinator (APC) on proper GTCC use prior to detaching for a PCS.

title: MANDATORY USE OF THE GOVERNMENT TRAVEL CHARGE CARD (GTCC) DURING PERMANENT CHANGE OF STATION (PCS) TRAVEL
text: The command must document the training with a signed Page 13 during the command check-in/checkout process.

title: MANDATORY USE OF THE GOVERNMENT TRAVEL CHARGE CARD (GTCC) DURING PERMANENT CHANGE OF STATION (PCS) TRAVEL
text: This counseling must also include a signed DD Form 3120 Statement of Understanding and be retained on file.

title: MANDATORY USE OF THE GOVERNMENT TRAVEL CHARGE CARD (GTCC) DURING PERMANENT CHANGE OF STATION (PCS) TRAVEL
text: Dislocation Allowance is an unauthorized use for the GTCC and will be provided as an advance.

title: MANDATORY USE OF THE GOVERNMENT TRAVEL CHARGE CARD (GTCC) DURING PERMANENT CHANGE OF STATION (PCS) TRAVEL
text: Sailors must check-out with their detaching APC to confirm a zero dollar balance on the GTCC, provide updated contact information, and verify their GTCC is ready for use.

title: MANDATORY USE OF THE GOVERNMENT TRAVEL CHARGE CARD (GTCC) DURING PERMANENT CHANGE OF STATION (PCS) TRAVEL
text: Detaching APCs must review CitiManager to ensure the traveler's GTCC account is in PCS mission critical status 5 days prior to the approved detachment date and ensure it remains in PCS mission critical status for the duration of the travel period.

title: MANDATORY USE OF THE GOVERNMENT TRAVEL CHARGE CARD (GTCC) DURING PERMANENT CHANGE OF STATION (PCS) TRAVEL
text: Sailors must work with their detaching APC during the travel period for credit limit increases.

title: MANDATORY USE OF THE GOVERNMENT TRAVEL CHARGE CARD (GTCC) DURING PERMANENT CHANGE OF STATION (PCS) TRAVEL
text: Sailors will check-in with the gaining CPPA to submit their travel voucher to Transaction Service Center (TSC) Memphis via Enterprise Customer Relationship Management (eCRM) within 5 working days and before executing any permissive TDY.

title: MANDATORY USE OF THE GOVERNMENT TRAVEL CHARGE CARD (GTCC) DURING PERMANENT CHANGE OF STATION (PCS) TRAVEL
text: Commands not supported by TSC Memphis, such as carriers and sub- tenders and who have their own Accounting and Disbursing Station Number (ADSN), will submit PCS travel claims to their respective PCS travel office for processing.

title: MANDATORY USE OF THE GOVERNMENT TRAVEL CHARGE CARD (GTCC) DURING PERMANENT CHANGE OF STATION (PCS) TRAVEL
text: Cardholders must ensure all required receipts are submitted with their travel claim and review their GTCC account for accuracy.

title: MANDATORY USE OF THE GOVERNMENT TRAVEL CHARGE CARD (GTCC) DURING PERMANENT CHANGE OF STATION (PCS) TRAVEL
text: GTCC must be paid in full upon travel claim liquidation.

title: MANDATORY USE OF THE GOVERNMENT TRAVEL CHARGE CARD (GTCC) DURING PERMANENT CHANGE OF STATION (PCS) TRAVEL
text: Sailors will be reimbursed for PCS expenses up to their maximum entitlement and all available funds due will be used to pay off GTCC balance.

title: MANDATORY USE OF THE GOVERNMENT TRAVEL CHARGE CARD (GTCC) DURING PERMANENT CHANGE OF STATION (PCS) TRAVEL
text: Service Members must each use their own GTCC for respective PCS expenses (meals, fuel, etc.) and file separate travel vouchers for individual travel. b.

title: MANDATORY USE OF THE GOVERNMENT TRAVEL CHARGE CARD (GTCC) DURING PERMANENT CHANGE OF STATION (PCS) TRAVEL
text: Sailors must pay CitiBank directly for TLA expenses. c.
